et Paulo, atque Andrea, et omnibus Sanctis.” (secret)

VARIANT [requiem] At a Requiem the Agnus Dei takes the 'dona eis requiem' substitutions, the
three breast strikes are OMITTED, and the priest's hands remain joined throughout instead of the
left hand going to the corporal and the right to the breast.
UNRESOLVED: The approved record has the servers kneel and bow throughout the Agnus Dei but does
not grade the depth of their bow.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
